access_rules_window_order.name: access_rules_window_order
access_rules_window_order.value: "access_rules"."window_start" IS NULL OR "access_rules"."window_end" IS NULL OR "access_rules"."window_end" > "access_rules"."window_start"

carriers_stock_unassigned.name: carriers_stock_unassigned
carriers_stock_unassigned.value: ("carriers"."state" = 'stock' AND "carriers"."credential_id" IS NULL) OR ("carriers"."state" <> 'stock' AND ("carriers"."credential_id" IS NOT NULL OR "carriers"."state" IN ('retired','lost')))

breach_alerts_ack_consistent.name: breach_alerts_ack_consistent
breach_alerts_ack_consistent.value: "breach_alerts"."state" = 'open' OR ("breach_alerts"."acked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "breach_alerts"."acked_by" IS NOT NULL)

breach_alerts_resolve_consistent.name: breach_alerts_resolve_consistent
breach_alerts_resolve_consistent.value: "breach_alerts"."state" <> 'resolved' OR ("breach_alerts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "breach_alerts"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("breach_alerts"."resolution_note")) > 0)

auth_sessions_ip_truncated.name: auth_sessions_ip_truncated
auth_sessions_ip_truncated.value: "auth_sessions"."ip_prefix" IS NULL OR masklen("auth_sessions"."ip_prefix") <= CASE family("auth_sessions"."ip_prefix") WHEN 4 THEN 24 ELSE 48 END
